<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#F9FAFA"/>
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="30" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  
  <!-- Status bar -->
  <text x="22" y="20" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="500" fill="#121212">9:41</text>
  <line x1="322" y1="18" x2="326" y2="18" stroke="#121212" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="329" y1="15" x2="329" y2="18" stroke="#121212" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="333" y1="12" x2="333" y2="18" stroke="#121212" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="337" y1="9" x2="337" y2="18" stroke="#121212" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="351" cy="15" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#121212" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="354" y1="18" x2="357" y2="21" stroke="#121212" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="365" y="10" width="20" height="11" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#121212" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="367" y="12" width="14" height="7" rx="2" fill="#5DB329"/>
  <rect x="386" y="13" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#121212"/>
  
  <!-- Header -->
  <rect x="0" y="30" width="390" height="68" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <polyline points="31,64 24,71 31,78" fill="none" stroke="#0A2533" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <line x1="25" y1="71" x2="40" y2="71" stroke="#0A2533" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <text x="58" y="76" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="22" font-weight="500" fill="#0A2533">Payment Method</text>
  <line x1="0" y1="98" x2="390" y2="98" stroke="#E6EBF2" stroke-width="1"/>
  
  <!-- Intro -->
  <text x="24" y="133" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="500" fill="#0A2533">Choose a payment method</text>
  <text x="24" y="156" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#666666">Your saved cards are ready for a faster checkout.</text>
  
  <!-- Visa card shadow and card -->
  <rect x="23" y="179" width="344" height="98" rx="12" fill="#063336" opacity="0.10"/>
  <g>
    <rect x="20" y="176" width="344" height="98" rx="12" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#5DB329" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="36" y="194" width="48" height="30" rx="5" fill="#F2F4F8"/>
    <text x="60" y="215" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="600" fill="#1D3A70">VISA</text>
    <text x="100" y="204" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="500" fill="#121212">Visa ending in 4242</text>
    <text x="100" y="226" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#666666">Expires 08/27</text>
    <rect x="36" y="239" width="59" height="20" rx="10" fill="#F3FAF6"/>
    <text x="65" y="253" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#267347">DEFAULT</text>
    <circle cx="329" cy="225" r="10" fill="#5DB329"/>
    <polyline points="324,225 328,229 335,221" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  </g>
  
  <!-- Mastercard card -->
  <rect x="23" y="293" width="344" height="98" rx="12" fill="#063336" opacity="0.10"/>
  <g>
    <rect x="20" y="290" width="344" height="98" rx="12" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E6EBF2" stroke-width="1"/>
    <rect x="36" y="308" width="48" height="30" rx="5" fill="#F2F4F8"/>
    <circle cx="57" cy="323" r="9" fill="#EC2A38"/>
    <circle cx="66" cy="323" r="9" fill="#FBBD00" opacity="0.9"/>
    <text x="100" y="318" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="500" fill="#121212">Mastercard ending in 8888</text>
    <text x="100" y="340" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#666666">Expires 11/26</text>
    <text x="36" y="367" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#999999">Personal card</text>
    <circle cx="329" cy="339" r="10" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#C7C7C7" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <polyline points="326,334 331,339 326,344" fill="none" stroke="#666666" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  </g>
  
  <!-- card actions -->
  <g>
    <rect x="20" y="410" width="344" height="54" rx="10" fill="#5DB329"/>
    <line x1="151" y1="437" x2="151" y2="449" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="145" y1="443" x2="157" y2="443" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="191" y="449" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">Add new card</text>
  </g>
  <text x="24" y="499" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="500" fill="#0A2533">Payment security</text>
  <rect x="20" y="516" width="344" height="86" rx="12" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E6EBF2" stroke-width="1"/>
  <circle cx="51" cy="548" r="14" fill="#F3FAF6"/>
  <rect x="46" y="543" width="10" height="10" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#4B9460" stroke-width="1.6"/>
  <polyline points="48,543 48,540 54,540 54,543" fill="none" stroke="#4B9460" stroke-width="1.6"/>
  <text x="77" y="546" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="500" fill="#121212">Your payment information is secure</text>
  <text x="77" y="568" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#666666">We use secure encryption to protect your card details.</text>
  <text x="77" y="586" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#5DB329">Learn more</text>
  
  <!-- checkout preference -->
  <text x="24" y="641" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="500" fill="#0A2533">Checkout preference</text>
  <rect x="20" y="657" width="344" height="58" rx="10" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E6EBF2" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="36" y="682" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="500" fill="#121212">Use default payment method</text>
  <text x="36" y="701" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#666666">Visa ending in 4242</text>
  <rect x="316" y="674" width="34" height="20" rx="10" fill="#5DB329"/>
  <circle cx="340" cy="684" r="7" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  
  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <rect x="0" y="758" width="390" height="86" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="758" x2="390" y2="758" stroke="#E6EBF2" stroke-width="1"/>
  <g>
    <polygon points="39,782 49,774 59,782 59,795 39,795" fill="none" stroke="#999999" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <polyline points="35,782 49,770 63,782" fill="none" stroke="#999999" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <text x="49" y="816" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#999999">Home</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="127" cy="784" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#999999" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <line x1="134" y1="791" x2="141" y2="798" stroke="#999999" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="127" y="816" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#999999">Search</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="184" y="775" width="27" height="20" rx="5" fill="none" stroke="#999999" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <polygon points="190,795 194,801 199,795" fill="#999999"/>
    <circle cx="192" cy="785" r="1.5" fill="#999999"/>
    <circle cx="199" cy="785" r="1.5" fill="#999999"/>
    <text x="197" y="816" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#999999">Messages</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="293" cy="780" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#5DB329" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <ellipse cx="293" cy="795" rx="12" ry="6" fill="none" stroke="#5DB329" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <text x="293" y="816" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#5DB329">Profile</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="355" cy="779" r="3" fill="#999999"/>
    <line x1="347" y1="787" x2="363" y2="787" stroke="#999999" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="347" y1="793" x2="363" y2="793" stroke="#999999" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="355" y="816" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#999999">More</text>
  </g>
</svg>
